cases.name: Vickie Lynne Ryno-Smith
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative: The Kern County Fire Department responded to reports of a house fire at around 10 a.m. June 30. After putting the fire out, KCFD found her body located in the master bedroom, covered in burns. Kern County Coroner Supervisor Annette Ugalde noted a deep slash mark on Vickie’s neck and it is believed she died prior to the fire.

cases.name: Kathryn "Katie" Dawn Pham
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Growing up, she particularly enjoyed swimming, horseback riding, archery, Santa Monica beach and Disneyland. She loved to swing dance with Dad and bake with Mom. She adored animals and spent hours at the Animal Shelter playing with dogs and cats. At age 13, she fell in love with cheerleading. She cheered for IWV, and was a JV and Varsity cheerleader for Burroughs High School. Her loves were her siblings, Brooklynn, Austin, Madison Frank and her dog, Buddy. Katie was a loving and compassionate person with the biggest heart. She was known for her beautiful smile and two dimples that could light up your soul."
